01
Friday · 30 October 2026 · Hong Kong

Forum recap

Held under the theme “We Are Better Together”, the Forum was designed to strengthen strategic alignment, deepen technical engagement and accelerate business growth through closer collaboration across our APAC partner ecosystem.

~128attendees
80partner representatives
48NI team members

Inspiring keynotes

  • APAC business outcomes & market outlook
  • NI strategy, software & platform roadmaps
  • Growth priorities & partner investment

Application breakouts

  • 3 rounds of 1-hour sessions
  • High-growth applications & products
  • Interactive format

Demos & innovation showcase

  • Live partner & NI demos
  • Customer success stories
  • Joint solution & go-to-market ideas

Partner awards

  • Long-term partnership milestones
  • New Platinum Partners
  • Six sub-regional MVPs

Partner Q&A

  • Partner commitment
  • Technology & AI investment
  • Ease of doing business & market shifts

Dinner & Gallery of Possibilities

  • Partner Engagement Dinner
  • Partner successes as AI-generated art
  • Celebrating shared achievements

Global Partner Day shares where NI is going. The APAC Partner Forum focuses on how NI and our partners win together in APAC: regional, interactive and application-oriented.

Share your partner success story

Built something great with NI? Tell us about it, for next year’s Forum and future APAC partner events.

Share your success story → No slides needed · one short form
  • Partner company, country / market and use case title
  • Your NI Partner Manager
  • Challenge · Solution delivered · Why the partner and NI won · Result and next opportunity
  • Customer name (or anonymous) and customer permission
  • Optional: a link to an approved visual (diagram, test image or product photo)

Questions about the Forum or your story? Contact your NI Partner Manager.
